entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A brave knight and planeswalker with a strong sense of duty and mastery of radiant magic, who searches for a new home and peace.

entities.name: The Phyrexians
entities.description: Horrifying invaders who invaded Elspeth's home plane when she was a child.

events.summary: As a child, Elspeth's plane is invaded by the Phyrexians and she is taken captive.
events.quote: As a child, her plane was invaded by the horrifying Phyrexians.

events.summary: Elspeth escapes captivity when her Spark ignites and has since searched for a new home.
events.quote: Taken captive, she escaped when her Spark ignited and has since searched for a new home.

relations.note: They invaded her plane and took her captive.
relations.quote: Taken captive, she escaped when her Spark ignited
